verification_description: Annual tax amount - if not found, this is not a tax summary

annual_taxes.description: Annual property tax amount (REQUIRED for verification)

millage_rate.description: Tax millage/mill rate confirmed by the Title Company, if stated (used for New Construction tax calcs, RM Job Aid p.14)

assessed_value.description: Assessed value used to calculate the tax bill

is_delinquent_60_plus_days.description: True if taxes are 60+ days delinquent (must be listed as a payoff, not in Section 900, per RM Job Aid p.14)

exemptions.description: Exemptions listed on the tax bill (e.g. 'homestead' for the prior owner) — must be excluded from a purchaser's tax estimate unless the buyer also qualifies (RM Job Aid p.14)
